title: Cohort A — Authoring Productivity Measurement
methodology: Measured elapsed wall-clock time for 3 complete Analyze upgrades (EC expansion + distractor rewrite + CL change per item) using S836 Quality-First Pipeline stages

stage_2_stem_assess.action: No stem changes needed for Analyze upgrade on calculation items

stage_3_independent_solve.action: Verified all 3 stored CC values correct by independent recalculation

comparison_to_s840_pilot.s849_measured_velocity: 2.73 min/item (21.9 items/hr) — actual performance on Batch 0
comparison_to_s840_pilot.discrepancy_analysis: S840 estimate was based on full 6-stage pipeline with human review latency. S849 actual is AI agent velocity for items where the stem does not change (pure explanation upgrade). The S840 pipeline assumed stem enhancement + full independent solve verification. S849 items are calculation-heavy — stem unchanged, only EC and distractors expanded. The 8x speedup reflects: (a) no stem changes, (b) parallel tool execution, (c) automated structural verification.
comparison_to_s840_pilot.applicable_scenario: Analyze upgrade where stem already supports higher cognitive level and only explanation layer needs expansion
